name: mrope_fused
description: Fused multimodal RoPE for query and key. q is [T,n_qh*head_size], k is [T,n_kh*head_size], cos_sin_cache is [max_pos,rotary_dim], and positions is [3,T] int64. The first rotary_dim/2 pairs are split into temporal, height and width sections by mrope_section; each pair selects cos/sin from the corresponding position row, then applies neox-style rotation to the first and second halves of each head. Dimensions beyond rotary_dim are copied unchanged. Returns newly allocated (q_out,k_out) with q/k shapes. Current tests exercise bfloat16 with head_size 64/128, rotary_dim 64/128 and T up to 8192.
